observations: Full masonry perimeter now meets the native ground; earlier floating void is closed.
West loading door and loft window are readable in unchanged approach camera; existing foreground crystal is preserved.
Hoist and sorting equipment provide a cargo-work purpose for cart bay.
Above-floor fractured rock sides materially change the quarry silhouette while retaining the original gantry and open encounter areas.
limits: Large native terrace planes remain visually simple; this is not full-city high-fidelity acceptance.
Native import, actual gameplay occlusion, companion traversal and performance remain pending.
